race.comment: YOURE NOT THE KING (8) undefeated in three runs this campaign and gives every indication of running a strong mile. Finished like a rocket out wide when winning the Greys BM90 as fav over 1400m at Flemington. King sticks and looks hard to stop again. MAN OF WORTH (5) bounced off his good first up third, with a dominant on speed win over 1500m at Randwick in this class. Should handle the weight increase from the good gate and looks the only danger. MUKHTALIF (11) has been kept fresh after he's struggled to close out his races this time in. Drops back to the mile and kept up to the mark with a 1214m trial. Can hold a position from the gate and stays in the mix. RIVELLINO (3) looks to be back on track after his two runs this prep in unsuitable races. Eye catching run in the G1 Golden Eagle over 1500m at Randwick. Massive class drop and he should relish the solid tempo. SOSINO (10) gets a better setup for this after having no luck in the Little Dance over 1600m at Randwick.
